recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Shared foundations: date helpers + shared types
recommended_phases.rationale: Extract startOfUtcDay/addMonths/periodContaining into src/shared/date/accrual.ts (pure UTC arithmetic, no balance-domain knowledge) and add EmployeeProfile + LeaveRequestQueryParams.employeeIds to shared-types. No module depends on these yet, so this is the dependency root and must land first.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Employee: password_hash, findByManagerId, profile mapping
recommended_phases.rationale: Add the nullable password_hash migration, extend IEmployeeRepository with findByManagerId, extend IEmployeeService with getEmployeeByEmail/getEmployeesByManagerId/getEmployeeProfileById, and add toEmployeeProfile (never exposes password_hash). auth and balance/leave read paths depend on these.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Policy: getAllPolicies exposure
recommended_phases.rationale: Add IPolicyService.getAllPolicies() calling the existing ILeavePolicyRepository.findAll(). Balance's getCurrentBalances iterates policies, so this must precede the balance work. No new repository method.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4 — Auth module: POST /auth/login
recommended_phases.rationale: New auth module with IAuthService.login(email, password) using bcrypt.compare + signToken (sub=id, role=EmployeeRole), indistinguishable wrong-email/wrong-password response, and public-path registration. Depends only on employee + shared-auth.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5 — Balance: getCurrentBalances + GET /balances/me
recommended_phases.rationale: Add IBalanceService.getCurrentBalances(employeeId) iterating active effective policies (via policy.getAllPolicies), deriving the current period via shared-date periodContaining, omitting types with no balance row ([] when none). Depends on phases 1-3.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 6 — Leave reads: list/getById + GET /leaves, GET /leaves/:id
recommended_phases.rationale: Extend findByQuery to honour employeeIds (employee_id = ANY($n)), add ILeaveService.list(actor, query) and getById(actor, requestId) with role scoping (EMPLOYEE self, MANAGER self+direct reports via employee.findByManagerId, ADMIN all) and 404-equivalence for invisible ids. Depends on employee + shared-types.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 7 — GET /employees/me route + smoke/unit tests
recommended_phases.rationale: Wire the employee profile route, extend scripts/smoke.js with login + authenticated read probes asserting real values, and add unit tests for new routes/services in the existing style. Depends on all prior phases.

app_notes: Application slice for "Authentication and read endpoints (v3)". Layer boundaries: presentation = Fastify routes (no controller layer, per binding rule 5); application = service interfaces/implementations; domain = models + repositories; infrastructure = shared/db (pg Pool, IUnitOfWork), shared/auth (JWT), shared/date (UTC accrual arithmetic). Dependencies flow inward only; leave remains the sole orchestrator and no module depends back on it. New modules: auth (login), shared-date (extracted accrual helpers). Extended modules: employee (password_hash, findByManagerId, profile mapping), policy (getAllPolicies), balance (getCurrentBalances), leave (list/getById reads). Shared value types used by >1 module (EmployeeProfile, LeaveRequestQueryParams.employeeIds) live in src/shared/types; LeavePolicyStatus remains module-local (imported via policy index.ts) — flagged as an open question. Read endpoints never open a transaction and never write. Role scoping for GET /leaves and GET /leaves/:id is identical (EMPLOYEE self; MANAGER self + direct reports via employee.findByManagerId, one level; ADMIN all) and is pushed into findByQuery via employeeIds (employee_id = ANY($n)) — no SQL in services, no fetch-all-then-filter. GET /balances/me iterates active effective policies (at most one per leaveTypeCode: ACTIVE, effective_from <= asOf, effective_to null or >= asOf, latest effective_from on tie), derives the current period via shared-date periodContaining, and omits leave types with no balance row ([] when none). POST /auth/login uses bcrypt.compare + signToken (sub=id, role=EmployeeRole), returns an indistinguishable wrong-email/wrong-password response, and is added to the public path set. password_hash is never returned in any response body.

open_questions.question: Should a controller layer be introduced, or continue with routes calling services directly?
open_questions.impact: Affects file layout for the new auth/employee/balance/leave read routes; current codebase has no controller layer and binding rule 5 says routes call services directly.
candidate_options: Continue routes-call-services (matches existing leave.routes.ts and binding rule 5)

open_questions.question: Should LeavePolicyStatus be promoted into src/shared/types as a canonical enum?
open_questions.impact: balance.getCurrentBalances must filter policies by status ACTIVE; if the enum stays module-local in policy.model.ts, balance imports it through policy's public entry point (allowed), but it is inconsistent with other canonical enums.
candidate_options: Keep module-local and import via policy index.ts

auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: EmployeeRole } where EmployeeRole = 'EMPLOYEE' | 'MANAGER' | 'ADMIN'. Identity/role obtained from a JWT bearer token verified by the existing registerAuth preHandler (src/shared/auth/index.ts), which populates request.user from payload.sub (id) and payload.role. RBAC is enforced at the API boundary by resolveActor (validates presence + role membership) and in services (role-scoped visibility), never inline in routes. POST /auth/login is added to the public path set so it is reachable without a token; all other new endpoints require a valid token.
error_response_contract: Errors return { error: string; code: string }. Validation failure -> HTTP 400 (ValidationError); authentication failure -> 401 (UnauthorizedError); authorization failure -> 403 (ForbiddenError); not found -> 404 (NotFoundError); invalid state transition -> 409 (ConflictError); other -> 500. POST /auth/login returns the SAME status and message for wrong email and wrong password (401 UnauthorizedError) to prevent account enumeration. GET /leaves/:id returns the SAME 404 NotFoundError for a request the caller may not see as for one that does not exist.
